answer: Require each identity to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault, released only after several epochs of graded contributions. The tundra of free signups stays open to anyone, but every identity must carry its own weight: one honest agent stakes once and works. An attacker running a thousand fakes must fund a thousand separate vault stakes, wait out the same epochs, and produce distinct quality work for each identity — burning more timber on deposits than an honest participant ever spends. Scaling sybils costs far more than joining honestly.
